EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A cold front moved across Massachusetts, bringing thunderstorms and downpours to Southeast Massachusetts and especially over Cape Cod.  Up to 4.5 inches of rain fell on Cape Cod during the morning and early afternoon.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: At 9:51 AM EST, heavy rain brought up to a foot of water to Main Street in Orleans, in front of Friends Marketplace. Water was up to the wheel wells and floorboards of SUVs.  At 9:52 AM, heavy rain flooded the basement of the Orleans District Court on Rock Harbor Road.

EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A cold front stalled over Southern New England on the 11th.  Low pressure from the Midwest then moved slowly east along the front. The weather system drew upon warm and very humid air to create showers with local downpours, resulting in rainfall amounts of two to five inches in Northern Massachusetts on August 11th and 12th.  An exceptionally powerful downpour left 8.15 inches in the city of Lynn.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: At 1:55 PM EST, two cars were trapped in flooding at the intersection of Market Street and Parker Street in Lawrence.

EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A cold front moved into New England the evening of August 7th and stalled just north of Massachusetts.  The airmass over the state was very humid and unstable. This generated strong thunderstorms, some causing damage. The front lingered north and west of the state on August 8th, forming thunderstorms and downpours in Massachusetts on that day, especially near Natick.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: At 6:30 PM EST, Dunster Drive in Stow was reported flooded and impassable.
